hypotheses.rationale: The Planner incorrectly interpreted the available data, mistaking 'well depths' (total drilled length) for 'depth-to-water' values. This led to the erroneous conclusion that specific depth-to-water data was missing, forcing the agent to perform further searches instead of correctly identifying the aquifer name from the context already available. This failure to verify the column meaning propagated through the entire run.
